name: Smiling Mind

short_description: A free meditation and mindfulness app from Australian non-profit Smiling Mind, with 700+ lessons and practices, kids' programs and mood check-ins.
long_description: Smiling Mind is a free mental fitness app made by Smiling Mind, an Australian non-profit. The App Store listing describes more than 700 lessons, practices and meditations and 50+ collections, organised around five skills: living mindfully, flexible thinking, growing connections, acting purposefully and recharging the body. There is content for children aged 5–12 and for adults, sleep and stress programs, mood check-ins, offline downloads and meditations in three Indigenous Australian languages. The app is free with no in-app purchases listed. In a 2022 randomised trial with 211 Australian public servants, the Smiling Mind workplace app did not reduce perceived stress compared with a waitlist when used alone; people who also attended four classes had lower distress at 3 and 6 months. Its privacy policy follows Australian privacy law, lets you delete your account, and allows third-party marketing cookies (such as Meta and Google) on its website if you opt in.
patient_summary: You pick short guided meditations or programs for yourself or your child (ages 5–12), for things like stress, calm and sleep, and can check in on your mood. The app is free with no subscription. It is a self-help tool, not therapy.

pricing.notes: No subscription; the App Store lists no in-app purchases. Run by a non-profit.

privacy.notes: Does not say it sells data; website marketing cookies from Meta and Google are used if you opt in. Follows Australian privacy law, not HIPAA; archived copies kept for 7 years after deletion.

seo.title: Smiling Mind: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Smiling Mind is a free mindfulness and meditation app from Australia with 700+ practices, including programs for children aged 5–12 and families.

faqs.q: How much does Smiling Mind cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Smiling Mind before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Smiling Mind replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Smiling Mind is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Smiling Mind?
faqs.a: Smiling Mind is available on iPhone and Android.

clinical_trials.outcome: No effect on perceived stress (primary outcome) vs waitlist; app plus classes lowered distress and raised mindfulness at 3 and 6 months, app alone showed no significant change.
